topic: Hatch chile tacos grown on the ISS
hook: Your tacos were grown in space.
title: Astronauts Grew Chile Peppers for Tacos in Orbit
description:
In 2021, astronauts on the International Space Station grew Hatch chile peppers, picked them and ate them in tacos. NASA shared photos of the meal. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #Space #IfYouWereInSpace
